The '''Nimat system''' was located in the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]], which connected it to the [[Junkfort system|Junkfort]] and [[Tammar system/Legends|Tammar systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Nimat [[Star system/Legends|system]] shared its name with the [[Nimat Corridor]], an Outer Rim region that included the<ref name="Polyhedron">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}}</ref> Tharin [[Sector/Legends|sector's]]<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Annoo system/Legends|Annoo system]].<ref name="Polyhedron" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nimat system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square T-8.<ref name="TEA" />
